premises.fact: A fresh native run fixes the archive to the singleton parent initial and requires an initial directory.
Every archive member becomes eligible only after native code reads overall_performance.accuracy_score and the unresolved, empty-patch and resolved identifier lists.
Any missing field is caught and the parent is skipped, leaving no eligible initial parent.
Every nondegenerate self-edit route selects from eligible parents; the frozen V8 route requests one random parent.
V9 forbids restoring excluded initial outcomes and forbids inventing, zero-filling or imputing the required prior-performance fields.
V9 forbids changing parent eligibility, selection, self-edit, evaluation or archive-update semantics and rejects zero-action evasions.

conclusion: No lawful outcome-free initialization adapter can preserve the exact native C3 semantics at this source identity.
scope_boundary: This is not an impossibility result for future DGM designs. It is a byte-bound interface impossibility for the exact released source and V9 constraints.
